title: Proactive Policing of Internet and Blocking of Violent Content Accessible to Children and Youths in Singapore
what_it_is: Proactive Policing of Internet and Blocking of Violent Content Accessible to Children and Youths in Singapore

sections.label: Internet content prohibition and cyber wellness
sections.summary: The Internet Code of Practice prohibits objectionable content, and IMDA can direct takedowns and blocks, while schools teach cyber wellness.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Communications and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Under the Internet Code of Practice, content which is objectionable on the grounds of public interest, public order or public security is prohibited.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Communications and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: In considering what is prohibited material, one factor taken into account is "whether the material depicts detailed or relished acts of extreme violence or cruelty".

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Communications and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: The Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) has powers under the Broadcasting Act to direct Internet Content Providers to take down prohibited material, as well as direct Internet Service Providers to block access to websites that contain such material.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Communications and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: IMDA also requires Internet Service Providers to offer Internet parental control services to their subscribers.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Communications and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Given the dynamic and borderless nature of the Internet, we cannot realistically block every website with undesirable content.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Communications and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: It is equally important to teach our young how to navigate the Internet safely.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Communications and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: This is why our schools conduct cyber wellness lessons for students, where students learn to identify and avoid inappropriate online content.

sections.label: Better Internet Campaign awareness rate
sections.summary: MLC's survey found its 2020 Better Internet Campaign had a 60% awareness rate for educational tips, with room to improve.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Communications and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Based on MLC’s survey, its 2020 Better Internet Campaign had an awareness rate of 60% for educational tips on issues such as positive Internet usage and digital footprint.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Communications and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: There is clearly room to improve and we will continue to build on existing efforts.
